company_name: Philippine Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — DTI promotes the semiconductor industry in the Philippines but does not directly manufacture or provide semiconductor products.
summary: The Philippine Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is instrumental in advancing the semiconductor and electronics industry in the Philippines through strategic policies and innovation-driven programs. It actively promotes the country as a competitive destination for electronics and semiconductor investments globally.

regional_presence.Philippines: DTI operates various programs and offices to support the semiconductor industry and attract investments in the Philippines.
